title: Summer sunset and glorious views at Cabana with Lisbon Digital Nomads 🌇🍷
description: Get ready for another magical rooftop evening! We are heading back to **Cabana** **Rooftop**, **JAM Hotel** — one of Lisbon’s most beautiful rooftops — for a night of relaxed summer energy, great conversations, and unforgettable sunset views over the city. Here is what is waiting for you: 🌞 **Happy Hour (7:30–8:30 PM)** Enjoy **20% off** Sonhar wine by the glass and Musa draft beer. 🌅 **Breathtaking views** Watch the Tejo glow as the sun sets across the horizon. 🧡 **Meaningful connections** Meet fellow digital nomads, creatives, and professionals in a warm, easy-going atmosphere. Whether you have just arrived in Lisbon or been here for years, this rooftop evening is the perfect place to unwind, connect, and enjoy a summer night above the city. This event is a casual social where we get drinks and talk to each other. There is no particular agenda, just good vibes and conversations. The idea is to meet some new people and hit it off. ***About us:*** We're a group of Nomads, Slowmads, Expats, and Locals who love to meet like-minded people and have a regular meetup running every Thursday since 2017! And the Nomad community is buzzing in Lisbon! Check out our socials to see photos and get updates: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/lisbondigitalnomads/) join our [Slack community](https://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack) to connect with others! We're all volunteers, these events are not for profit, and we try to find the most awesome ways to connect you on a personal and a professional level. ***Join our team:*** We're currently looking for talented community hosts to join our team. If you think you're up for the challenge of hosting our Thursday meetups and giving back to the community - [please apply to become a host](https://forms.gle/bD388ScQehorr2CH8). We would love to hear from you! ***Do you have a venue for 100+ people indoors? Partner with us:*** We have some spots available for venues that would like to host our Thursday meetups. Whether you're a nomad passing through Lisbon, staying for a season, living in Lisbon, or are an aspiring digital nomad, you're all welcome to join our events! **📣 Friendly reminder** Our meetups are all about creating a safe, inclusive, and welcoming space for everyone, even as our community grows. Bring your best vibe, treat others with kindness and respect, and make an effort to greet new faces. Remember, everyone has the right to their boundaries—whether it’s a hug, a dance, a drink, or a conversation. Let’s ensure our community thrives by treating each other as we’d like to be treated. Looking forward to meeting you! ***The Lisbon Digital Nomads Meetup Team*** PS - Join our Slack community [here](http://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack). description: Looking for a fun and friendly way to spend your Friday evening in Lisbon? Whether you live here, recently moved to the city, or you're simply passing through while travelling, you're very welcome to join us! International Friends Lisbon is a growing community of local Portuguese and international people who come together regularly. Some people are joining for the first time, while others return week after week to catch up with familiar faces. Come alone or bring your friends — either way, you'll be welcome! ❤️ 🃏 LET'S MAKE SOCIALISING EASIER! Walking into a busy social event can sometimes feel a little awkward - so we make it easier! We run fun matching and connection activities to get people moving around, talking and mixing with different people. Nothing complicated - just a bit of fun to get conversations started! 😄 🎁 FUN COMMUNITY RAFFLE We also have a fun raffle draw during the evening, adding a little extra excitement to the night! 🕖 COME EARLY & ENJOY THE WHOLE EVENING Doors open at 7:00 PM, and we strongly recommend arriving early. The first part of the evening is all about socialising, conversations, activities and enjoying the community atmosphere. 🎧 From around 11:00 PM, we have a DJ playing in one side of the venue giving you the choice between ending your night with a fun dance or continue socialising in other rooms of the venue. Most of our attendees stay till 1:00 AM. You're welcome to stay and enjoy the music until 3:00 AM. ❤️ FRIENDSHIP & COMMUNITY FIRST We want our events to be somewhere people feel comfortable coming back to week after week, seeing familiar faces and becoming part of the community. A few simple things help us keep that atmosphere: • Respect everyone's personal space and boundaries. • This is a friendship-focused community event. • Please avoid unwanted romantic pressure. • Please maintain respect on the dance floor. • Please don't use our events to promote business, services or other events. • Be friendly, considerate and help others feel included. Come to have fun, meet people and be a positive part of the community. ❤️ 💛 FREE TO ATTEND • DONATION BASED There's no fixed **entrance fee.** **If you'd like to support the community, please contribute whatever amount** you feel comfortable with when you arrive.
